snippet.title: Altered Alma | Coming to PlayStation and XBOX | CRTime
snippet.description:
Available to wishlist now on XBOX and PlayStation. Also coming to Nintendo Switch.

Play as Jack, a former enforcer who’s now on the run. Fast action and quick thinking will be your friends as you embark on this metroidvania adventure where your decisions will shape your gameplay - and your relationships!

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190700/Altered_Alma/
